business_problem: We have important challenges to solve, which we believe we'll achieve thanks to data and AI," says João Nascimento, Global CIO of EDP.
solution_summary: EDP modernized its analytics estate on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Vision, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. Fast forward to present day, the organization has now moved on to deploy machine learning, artificial intelligence and IoT technology to make even more of the data and insights it generates. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Vision
solution_components.role: Processes image content or visual signals used by the application.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
